subject: Pricing & Discount Follow-up: NovaAnalytics discovery
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@novaanalytics.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novaanalytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-19T15:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — NovaAnalytics + Redwood Inference

Hi Aisha / Tom — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a couple of follow-ups so we can size pricing and potential discounts: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary use: customer-facing summarization and search (real-time chat + background embeddings for retrieval).
- Expected bursts around product launches; baseline steady state traffic for 3 environments (staging/prod/ml).
- Security: need SOC2, VPC/private deployment later (sensitive PII).

Qualification items I need to confirm (numbers will drive unit economics):
1) Estimated token consumption (input+output) per month across environments — ballpark range is fine (e.g., 50M–200M tokens/mo).
2) Target cost goal: what is your procurement target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range?
3) Time horizon for committed usage (12mo vs 24mo) and appetite for upfront commitment.

We have a startup program and committed-use tiers that materially change unit pricing — happy to sketch options once I have the volumes and preferred budget range. I attached a short usage export template (novaanalytics-usage-export.csv) you can fill with rough numbers.

Next steps:
- Can you share a 3-month expected token run-rate (even ranges are fine) by end of day Friday?
- I’ll prepare 2 pricing scenarios: 1) Startup program + 12mo commit, 2) No commit (pay-as-you-go) with volume discount.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: novaanalytics-usage-export.csv (template)

Thanks Rishi — good call today. Aisha and I talked and can give rough numbers: 
- Pilot (first 3 months): 20M–30M tokens/month (mainly summarization).
- Production target (post-pilot, 12mo): 150M–250M tokens/month depending on adoption.
- Ideal procurement target: ~$800–1,200 per 1M tokens (we know this is high-level — want to understand tradeoffs).

We are a Series A startup (15 employees in infra/product); we’d be very interested in a startup program discount and a 12–24 month committed-use discount if it gets us to the target budget.

Can you put together a simple comparison of: PAYG vs 12mo commit vs 24mo commit (include suggested discounts and any multi-year incentives)? Also confirm whether reserved/dedicated capacity is required for the latency constraints or if hosted is fine for initial rollout.

Thanks,
Tom
Head of Product, NovaAnalytics
Tom.Reynolds@novaanalytics.com

Tom — great, thanks for the ranges and target $ goal. Below is a concise unit-economics sketch and two example pricing scenarios. I’ll attach a draft proposal as well.

Unit economics (illustrative):
- Baseline PAYG list rate: $2,500 / 1M tokens (depends on model family & quantization).
- Startup program: typically 30% off list for eligible early-stage companies + credits for evaluation.
- Committed-use tiers (example):
  - 12mo / 3M tokens/mo commit: additional 15% off post-startup discount; effective 
    price approx: list * (1 - startup) * (1 - commit)
  - 24mo / 6M tokens/mo commit: additional 25% off post-startup; multi-year incentives (price protection, 5% annual increase cap).

Rough examples for your target ~$1,000 / 1M tokens:
- PAYG: list $2,500 -> after volume-based discount at scale maybe down to $1,500–1,800 (no commit).
- Startup + 12mo commit: list $2,500 * 0.7 (startup) * 0.85 (commit) ≈ $1,488 -> additional negotiation possible for 12mo at higher commit.
- Startup + 24mo + multi-year incentive: list $2,500 * 0.7 * 0.75 ≈ $1,312 with price protection.

Notes & asks:
- If you can confirm a 12mo vs 24mo preference and a rough desired $/1M target (e.g., $1,000 vs $1,200), I’ll run a modeled pricing sheet with exact numbers and an initial commercial proposal.
- For latency today hosted is likely fine; if you hit dedicated tail-latency needs we can suggest Redwood Dedicated options and add-ons.

Attached: proposal-draft.pdf (initial), novaanalytics-usage-export.csv (your template).

I’ll also loop in Marissa for discount approvals for startup + commit.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-19T22:05:00Z
Subject: FWD: Pricing options — NovaAnalytics (startup + commit ask)

Folks — forwarding Tom/Aisha’s note. Quick ask: NovaAnalytics is Series A, potentially 150–250M tokens/mo in 12 months. They’ve asked about startup program plus 12/24mo committed-use discounts.

What I’m proposing we offer as a starting point (to present to customer):
- Startup program: 30% off list.
- 12mo commit (tiered by monthly commit): additional 15% off post-startup (effective ≈ 40–45% off list).
- 24mo commit: additional 25% off post-startup + price-protection language (effective ≈ 47–50% off list) and option for an extra 5% prepay incentive.

For internal approval: can we greenlight the startup program + up to 25% commit discount for this deal (deal_id RDW-2345)? If not, what guardrails? Also confirm whether a 5% prepay incentive is something we can offer from RevOps if they prepay annual commit.

I attached SOW-template.docx.

Thanks — need a reply by EOD tomorrow to keep momentum.

Rishi
Account Executive
